overall_summary: Data volume is small and overall view counts are generally low, but husband-wife relationship content clearly outperforms sibling, parental, or general shayari content by roughly 10x.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about wives/husbands (or5gtaBpRVY with 1671 views and my5mP9feI7s with 1766 views) significantly outperformed all other family or emotional shayari topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and relationship reality themes within the core channel topics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos about sisters, brothers, and heavy sad shayari (e.g., YdWh4cDOE64 with 12 views, jfmMztnam_A with 19 views) generated almost zero traction.
weak_patterns.action: Acknowledge low-sample limits but phase out purely poetic or sibling-focused rants for now.
